launch_slurm_job: launch a Slurm job by rendering an sbatch script from StoolArgs and submitting via sbatch or bash
copy_python_dir: copy a directory of Python files to an output directory using rsync with selective includes
retrieve_partition_max_time: retrieve the maximum time limits per Slurm partition by parsing sinfo JSON output
validate_stool_args: validate and set default values for StoolArgs including time limits, constraints, and conda paths
run_stool_cli: run the stool CLI module to parse arguments and launch a training job on a Slurm cluster
